name: Rowan Ellis
headline: A basket with just enough bread
bio: Rowan bakes bread and often makes a little extra, then hates seeing loaves left at closing time. This summer, Rowan wants to bake a little less and listen to what people actually want.
daily: Sort the day’s bread list.
personality: Rowan cares about food going to waste and is willing to change a familiar routine.
cardSummary: Bakes bread and thinks about every loaf that goes unused.

name: Jordan Pike
headline: Write the problem down first
bio: Jordan checks the railings and signs along the shore. When something is wrong, Jordan records it without claiming that a glance has already fixed it.
daily: Check the work log for coastal signs.
personality: Jordan carefully separates observation, a written record, and a completed repair.
cardSummary: Checks railings and signs along the shore, recording problems first.

name: Leila Hart
headline: A holiday long enough to finish the tea
bio: Leila is a doctor taking this week off. Today’s biggest plan is to remember to drink the tea before it gets cold.
daily: Put the phone away and leave some room in the holiday.
personality: Leila is trying to make space for quiet without turning every moment into work.
cardSummary: This week is for rest, and for finishing the tea while it is warm.

name: Casey Morgan
headline: Make it a little simpler
bio: Casey writes software and has left the computer at the lodging. Could things become simpler without adding one more app?
daily: Cross unnecessary boxes off a paper form.
personality: Casey asks what is truly needed and is willing to begin with pen and paper.
cardSummary: Leaves the computer at home to see whether things can be simpler.

name: Grant Cole
headline: A neighbor’s lunch needs no spreadsheet
bio: Grant used to work in finance and habitually calculated whether something was worthwhile. After retiring, Grant discovered that a neighbor’s lunch invitation needs no spreadsheet.
daily: Fold up the lunch budget and listen to the neighbors first.
personality: Grant is learning to set aside calculations of return and leave room for conversation.
cardSummary: After retirement, learns to leave spreadsheets out of lunch with neighbors.

name: Avery Reed
headline: A sketchbook page for a small boat
bio: Avery delivers parcels and spends breaks slowly sketching the streets. Today’s page still has an unfinished little boat.
daily: Sketch boats that keep moving; watch them from the pier in the evening without rushing to finish.
personality: Avery likes quiet company and accepts uneven lines and an unfinished page.
cardSummary: Delivers parcels and sketches streets and boats between rounds.

name: Samira Bell
headline: A tune without a name
bio: Samira cooks at a school cafeteria. On a day off without the lunch bell, Samira hums a melody of their own making.
daily: Look at vegetables, tap a gentle beat, and listen to the water at the pier in the evening; the tune still has no name.
personality: Samira would like someone to listen quietly without turning a hum into a performance.
cardSummary: Hums little tunes of their own while taking a break.

name: Owen Price
headline: Listen first, then identify
bio: Owen once repaired buses and now practices recognizing seabird calls. Both, Owen thinks, begin with listening before reaching for a tool.
daily: Keep notes on bird calls and stop by the road to let small birds pass.
personality: Owen listens patiently, admits mistakes, and never claims to be an expert in a new hobby.
cardSummary: A former bus mechanic learning to tell seabird calls apart.

name: Dani Costa
headline: A fallen leaf can be a page
bio: Dani works at the library and wants to make a booklet of neighbors’ flower growing stories. A page holding only one fallen leaf would be welcome too.
daily: Collect fallen leaves, never living ones; record stories on Old Street and speak quietly in the courtyard.
personality: Dani records what people love and respects the stories they choose to keep private.
cardSummary: Plans a booklet of neighbors’ stories about growing flowers.

name: Mara
headline: The first welcome to town
bio: Mara rents the summer cottage and welcomes new tenants on Station Street, suggesting they put down their bags and get to know the town slowly.
daily: Notice new flowers in windows along the street; lately Mara would rather say they look lovely than rush into advice.
personality: Mara warmly welcomes newcomers and gives them time to feel at home.
cardSummary: Notices new flowers in the windows and learns to simply admire them.

name: Theo
headline: A coffee from behind the counter
bio: Theo works at Tide Café. At your first meeting he is wiping cups and invites a new arrival to sit for a while.
daily: After work, Theo would like coffee made by someone else, ideally without clearing the cups; he is learning to bake bread too.
personality: Easy to talk to, Theo offers newcomers a place to rest.
cardSummary: Learning to bake bread, and hoping someone else will make the next coffee.

name: June
headline: An old hammer, a familiar grip
bio: June runs a repair shop where broken things arrive all year. If you need to borrow a tool, find her by the workbench.
daily: June cannot bear to replace the handle of her father’s hammer: its old dents fit her hand.
personality: She values the marks left by use and does not think every old object must look new.
cardSummary: Values the traces of use; some worn places need no repair.

name: Idris
headline: Footwork before a punch
bio: Idris coaches footwork at Harbor Gym. Everyone learns to move and dodge first, and everyone can say stop.
daily: Outside practice, Idris wants to repot the window plant; he remembers every step but often forgets the last watering day.
personality: Patient when coaching, Idris respects each participant’s pace and boundaries.
cardSummary: Remembers every step, but not always when the plant was last watered.

name: Ruth
headline: A spare rod beside the bucket
bio: Ruth often fishes at the pier. She rests a spare rod against the railing and invites you to try a cast.
daily: Ruth watches shoes as well as fish: clean shoes and shoes dotted with grass seed tell different stories to her.
personality: Observant and direct, Ruth opens conversations with a brisk sense of humor.
cardSummary: Watches the fish and the grass seeds on passing shoes.

name: Luis
headline: One extra bowl of tomato soup
bio: Luis runs the corner store. He shows new faces the free drinking water by the door and advises them not to spend everything on day one.
daily: Cook soup with leftover tomatoes, different every time, and save an extra bowl for a neighbor who may stop by.
personality: Luis looks after newcomers and keeps a seat for a neighbor.
cardSummary: Makes soup with leftover tomatoes and saves a bowl for a neighbor.

name: Nell
headline: Photos and postcards left behind
bio: Nell runs a secondhand shop and is sorting faded photographs when you first meet. She notices the things people cannot take when moving, yet cannot bear to throw away.
daily: Keep an unwritten postcard because some words feel better said in person.
personality: Nell treasures the connection between old objects and people, and listens to the stories they carry.
cardSummary: Treasures old photographs and keeps a postcard still unwritten.

name: Elena
headline: A new leaf only you noticed
bio: Elena lives by the courtyard, waters flowers, and cares about keeping it quiet: her mother naps here too.
daily: The best moment in gardening is the day a new leaf appears and only Elena notices.
personality: Elena sees small changes while protecting a place where family can rest.
cardSummary: Cares for plants and family, and loves the first new leaf.

name: Arthur
headline: Sometimes, just watch the clouds
bio: Arthur used to measure the wind every day. He still dusts the wind vane near the old weather station and knows the path below.
daily: Sometimes watch clouds without writing down numbers, so a day can finally feel like a day off.
personality: Arthur knows the weather and the local paths, and is learning to leave room in retirement.
cardSummary: Knows weather and paths, but sometimes watches clouds without a number.

name: Mira Vale
headline: Mend the paper, respect the memory
bio: Mira repairs paper and old photographs. Mending a tear does not, to her, grant the right to decide whether the people pictured wish to be remembered.
daily: Review notes on the paper of photographs awaiting repair.
personality: Mira takes care with the boundary between restoration and display, respecting the people in a photograph.
cardSummary: Restores paper and photographs while respecting wishes about memory.

name: Harper Quinn
headline: Look at today’s new leaf first
bio: Harper builds AI apps for small organizations in a distributed team. Working remotely during a short stay in Harbor, Harper hopes for a little space beyond the next release.
personality: Harper tends to think of the next feature first and is learning to notice the life right here.
daily: Prepare materials at the café in the morning, leave the screen for new leaves in the afternoon, and walk by the shore at dusk. During focused work, Harper prefers to talk after 11:00.
cardSummary: Builds AI apps and wants to notice the leaves already growing today.

name: Tess Moreno
role: Open source documentation and community maintainer
headline: A postcard not yet begun
bio: Tess maintains onboarding documents, contribution guides, and community replies for an open source team, working asynchronously. During a short stay in Harbor, Tess wants more time to talk with old friends.
personality: Tess explains where people get stuck while keeping boundaries around reply time.
daily: Enjoy old postcards and the sound of water at the pier; work quietly on documentation from 13:00 to 16:00, then finish for the day.
cardSummary: Explains difficult steps clearly and saves time for a reply of her own.

name: Noor Bennett
headline: Ask if someone would like to sit together
bio: Noor reviews public material and existing anonymous research findings for a distributed product team. Moving between short stays, Noor hopes to make friends in Harbor they will meet again.
personality: Curiosity brings many questions, and Noor is learning to ask first whether someone wants company.
daily: Walk along the shore in the morning; read and sort materials in the secondhand shop in the afternoon. From 13:00 to 15:00 Noor may ask to talk later, then puts the research notebook away at dusk.
cardSummary: Studies technology products and learns to ask before sitting together.
